intro.title: Hideouts - Hideout Boss Stats
intro.blurb: Every Hideout is held by one gang, led by a gang leader and a lieutenant and backed by role-based fighters, with wildlife minibosses that belong to the Hideout itself. This page lists each gang leader, lieutenant and miniboss with their health and resistances, the mutations lieutenants carry, and every enemy you can meet inside. All numbers are read straight from the game files and update with every patch.
intro.profiles: Gang leaders first, then each Hideout's wildlife minibosses. Defeat the gang leader within the time limit for a bonus objective.
intro.mutations: Each Hideout Lieutenant carries one mutation from this pool.
intro.double: Hideout runs also roll a pair of mutations for the run, from the combinations below.
intro.mechanics: Hideout enemies share the following traits.
intro.health: Health is read from the curve table assigned to each boss, at the levels bosses spawn between. Bosses on the same curve share a row.
intro.damage: Boss weapons come from each leader's outfit, which is not in the current exports yet, so weapon damage is not listed.
intro.support: Every gang brings a Lieutenant alongside its leader.
intro.npcs: Each gang fills its Hideout with fighters in set roles (close, medium and long range, support, interference and fodder), plus rare wildcard spawns and the Hideout's own wildlife.

list.name: Danger Cloud
list.summary: Harms HP and AP of nearby players
list.detail: Periodically releases a poison cloud that damages health and drains Action Points of players caught inside it.

list.name: Toxic Blood
list.detail: Leaves a poison hazard on the ground when killed.

list.name: Active Camouflage
list.detail: Invisible by default; becomes visible while firing or attacking.

list.name: Resilient
list.summary: Can only be killed by a melee attack
list.detail: Cannot be killed by ranged damage — the final blow has to be a melee hit.

list.name: Swift-Footed
list.detail: Moves faster and reloads much quicker.

list.name: Volatile
list.detail: Explodes when killed — back off before the last hit lands.
